queries: Altman "losing money on openai pro subscriptions" January 2025

sources_considered.why: Reports Altman's 5 January 2025 statement that OpenAI was losing money on Pro subscriptions, which feature o1 pro.
Same statement; The Register was enough.

receipt.public_excerpt: "Insane thing: We are currently losing money on OpenAI Pro subscriptions!" he wrote in a post.

evidence_items.explanation: Altman said OpenAI was losing money on the $200 Pro tier. That is one subscription tier, not o1 as a whole, so it is partial and context only.

metric_scope.metric: Profit or loss on ChatGPT Pro subscriptions

receipt.public_excerpt: For the extra cash, users gain unlimited access to its advanced voice, o1 pro model, "which uses more compute for the best answers to the hardest questions."

evidence_items.explanation: Shows the loss-making Pro tier was built around o1 pro, which links Altman's remark to o1. It does not cover o1 sold through Plus or the API.

unresolved_gaps: No OpenAI disclosure or credible report gives o1's profit or loss across all channels (Plus, Pro, API) for the period.
OpenAI's company-wide losses are a different measure and do not isolate o1.
